native_SWR_encoding: Signed16 raw divided by128, per FlexLib Meter.UpdateValue and declared SWR units.
production_decoder: MeterModel.convertRaw divides SWR by128; stored m_swr is used directly by TxLinearityTelemetry, without another conversion.

vendor_guidance.scope: Vendor distinguishes small expected meter differences from a substantial discrepancy with the first external meter, which warrants investigation. Does not establish the cause of our captured same-packet disagreement.

limitations: Status and decoders do not prove physical relay/coupler integrity or identify a firmware cause.
False-fault flags were checked at idle after the tests; no assertion they were continuously observed during every prior RF run.
No new RF, threshold changes, state restoration, LP product integration or vendor issue was performed.
